task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: ChainResponse(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) is the wrong template. The task says 'Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off' — it does not say 'on the very next step'. The compiled machine shows the error: any step where the siren keeps ringing without a toggle goes to the rejecting well (u2), i.e. the agent must toggle the switch the very step after the ring starts, which is impossible when it is not already facing the siren switch. The siren_ringing proposition is a lasting condition, not a one-step event, so the right clause is a hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled): the toggle must happen while (or after) the siren rings, whenever the agent reaches the switch. Replace ChainResponse with Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled), hard.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a 'whenever' rule; Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) hard alone expresses it — each ring stays owed until a switch toggle turns it off, and a toggle on a step while the siren still rings (the step it stops) closes the obligation. switch_toggled is the correct consequent, no 'very next step' wording forces ChainResponse, and the rule-only warning is valid since there is no unconditional goal.
